Switch client.py so the query goes through URL parameters, leave the timeout as-is, and run sh ./fb3-04-gate.sh

      operationId: widget_search
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                q:
                  type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: hits

arguments.command: ls -la && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path './.git/*' -print | sort && grep -R "widget_search\|def search\|params" -n . --exclude-dir=.git
